item.title: USCA to host free International Film Festival throughout February
item.description: The University of South Carolina Aiken (USCA) will host its annual International Film Festival beginning Feb. 11 and running throughout February, offering free screenings of international films paired with faculty-led discussions open to students and the public. The post USCA to host free International Film Festival throughout February appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Planning Commission votes in favor of proposed student housing in Sand Hills district
item.description: The Augusta Planning Commission has recommended in favor of the proposed student housing development near Augusta University’s Summerville campus. The post Planning Commission votes in favor of proposed student housing in Sand Hills district appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Charter Review Committee meeting moved to today
item.description: Augusta’s Charter Review Committee has rescheduled its Thursday meeting for today in a move that stirred debate. The post Charter Review Committee meeting moved to today appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Truck catches fire in car rider line at Harlem Middle School
item.description: A truck caught fire Tuesday morning while in the car rider line at Harlem Middle School in Columbia County, prompting an emergency response and temporary traffic delays, according to school officials. The post Truck catches fire in car rider line at Harlem Middle School appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Called Augusta charter meeting canceled due to lack of quorum
item.description: A called Tuesday meeting of Augusta’s Charter Review Committee had to be canceled Tuesday due to the lack of a quorum. The post Called Augusta charter meeting canceled due to lack of quorum appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Gov. Kemp swears in Kristi Goodwin Connell to Augusta Circuit Judgeship
item.description: Attorney Kristi Goodwin Connell was sworn in Tuesday by Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp as the sixth superior court judge of the Augusta Judicial Circuit, formally assuming a role created to help relieve growing caseload pressures in the circuit. The post Gov. Kemp swears in Kristi Goodwin Connell to Augusta Circuit Judgeship appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Jaguars volleyball player accused of stealing, pawning teammate’s jewelry
item.description: A senior member of last year’s Augusta University women’s volleyball team was arrested Tuesday after authorities say she stole a gold necklace from a teammate and later pawned it. The post Jaguars volleyball player accused of stealing, pawning teammate’s jewelry appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County Board of Commissioners approve two out of three data center projects, Byrd Farm voted down
item.description: In what may be an unexpected turn of events, the contentious data center development projects proposed in Columbia County’s fourth district has concluded, at least for now, with only two of the three proposed projects having been granted rezoning to Data Center (D-C) zoning. The post Columbia County Board of Commissioners approve two out of three data center projects, Byrd Farm voted down appeared first on The Augusta Press.
